verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test organization for safely exercising APIs, the MCP server, or agents is a fair capability to ask of an observability SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a Datadog sandbox, test org, or non-production environment isolated from production data. The MCP server, API reference, CLI and feature-flag items describe other capabilities and do not establish sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
